# **How Swipe made quotation and invoicing hassle-free for Elephant AI Agency**


**Manish, co-founder of Elephant AI Agency** , shares how Swipe helped the creative advertising agency simplify its quotation and invoicing process while reducing repetitive manual work.


Elephant AI Agency focuses on design, data, advertising, and digital performance. Like most creative agencies, its team manages several responsibilities at once, including client communication, campaign planning, creative execution, and administrative tasks.


Among those administrative tasks, creating quotations and invoices manually had become unnecessarily time-consuming.


## **The challenge with manual quotations and invoices**


Before the implementation of Swipe, the team at Elephant AI Agency had been relying on word documents for creating invoices and quotations.


The process included opening a document, formatting it, entering the client and pricing information, saving the file, and sending it manually.


Although it seems easy to send an invoice from time to time, it becomes complicated when the team needs to manage several clients and projects.


Repetition of the same formatting and documentation work meant that the workers spent their time on an automated task instead of getting it done via the software.


## **How Elephant AI Agency discovered Swipe**


While searching for ways to automate its billing process, the team discovered Swipe, a browser-based invoicing and billing platform.


For Elephant AI Agency, what stood out about Swipe was its ease of use.


Rather than manually creating and formatting each document, Swipe simply requires entering the relevant details on both the client and the transaction, thus enabling the team to produce professional quotes and invoices very quickly.


This is especially useful for a creative agency working regularly with many clients since it simplifies the processes.


## **What changed after using Swipe**


Swipe assisted more organized workflow by revolutionizing an inefficient, manual process at Elephant AI Agency.


Some of the benefits of the transformation were:


- Quick generation of professional quotations without formatting each document manually.
- Simplified process of invoicing that saved time on the repetitive task, namely billing.
- Use of the browser as a platform, meaning that no installation of software was required.
- Quotations and invoices are stored and controlled in the same place with no need to search for various Word documents.
- The only thing that was needed from the agency was entering client and billing details while Swipe would create the document structure and format it.


As a result, the agency was able to produce high-quality documents for clients without wasting time on repetitive formatting.


## **Why Swipe works well for creative agencies**


Usually, innovative agencies pay attention to ideas, strategies, campaigns, designs, and achievements of clients.


The organisation of various operations, including invoicing and quotation creation, is essential, but it must not occupy a lot of the agency’s time.


Swipe made the process of doing these routine operations easier for Elephant AI Agency.


It also allowed the team to make the appearance of the documents regarding pricing and invoicing more uniform and presentable.


Agencies that handle a number of projects at the same time benefit from using effective invoicing and quotation software.


## **How Swipe has improved the agency's workflow**


Elephant AI Agency benefited greatly from a more standardised way of producing quotes and invoices.


Thanks to Swipe, the team can now easily use a standardised procedure instead of having to prepare a new document each time.


It saved the team the hassle of repeating the same work and made the billing process much more efficient.


The team spent the free time that it got from easier documentation on other tasks that helped achieve better results when working with clients, like developing campaigns and executing creative ideas, and measuring performance.


## **Final thoughts**


Swipe's story illustrates how even a small process can be automated to achieve tangible gains in day-to-day business.


The transition from manually generated Word documents to a structured invoice and quote generation platform enabled Elephant AI Agency to deliver faster service and create high-quality documents with ease.


For creative agencies and service companies that still rely on manual invoice and quote preparation, switching to an automated invoicing system can save many hours of needless administration.
